TASK_RECONCILIATION.TASK: Archive/StreamingAssets lookup probing exists in TryBootstrapLookupTables; missing payload falls back to GenerateEmergencyMockTables with 256 unmanaged edge masks.
No new Mesh(), mesh.vertices, SetVertices, RecalculateNormals, or SetData usage exists in the new module. GPU upload uses GraphicsBuffer.LockBufferForWrite and MemCpy.
ChunkMeshingStateDTO uses public fields only. Ref mutation is exposed through GetStateAsRef; read-only access through ref readonly.
VoxelVertexDTO is 32B; primary state/telemetry/AABB DTOs are 64B; no Pack=1.
MockVoxelDensityArray and GenerateMockVoxelDensitySphereJob fill a hollow sphere/sphere SDF without Agent 05 dependency.
SurfaceNetExtractionJob emits a centroid vertex for each sign-crossing cell and connects cell vertices through unmanaged index output.
Tetrahedral SDF gradient normal sampling packs normals and tangents into RGB10_A2 uints.

Async handoff state is represented by chunk stages and a boot-prewarmed GraphicsBuffer double-buffer dispatcher. Burst writes indirect args; upload performs no main-thread Mesh rebuild or upload-time buffer allocation.
Density workspace is 34^3, giving one ghost voxel around a 32^3 chunk for overlap sampling.
VoxelSurfacePriorityJob scores chunks using Camera AUP/frustum data; VoxelSurfaceHzbCullJob can reject CPU-downloaded HZB-occluded chunks. Tuning clamps max chunks/frame to 1..2.
GlobalQualityWeight controls exact 25%-100% sampling anchored at weight 0.2, stride 4..1, center-bias decimation, 5..60 Hz non-urgent cadence, and telemetry decimation ratio.
Biome/material blend is baked into ColorPacked.g; quality scalar into ColorPacked.b; UVs stay cheap and planar.
VoxelSurfaceDirtySignalJob marks laser-modified chunks dirty and priority 1 without direct Agent 05 reference.

No MeshCollider bake happens in Surface Nets. A physics bake request DTO/job stages mesh IDs for a physics-owned bridge because this module owns no managed Mesh and must preserve compile-wall isolation.
VoxelSurfaceAabbShiftJob shifts BRG AABB centers; generated vertices remain local float3.
Persistent workspace lives in GlobalDataVault handles. Runtime clears counters/state; no private NativeArray/NativeList fields are owned by the mesher.
300-frame telemetry ring and endian-marked dump writers target Dump_MESH_SURGEON.bin and Dump_SHINOBU_61.bin.
Voxel Mesh Tuner EditorWindow reads/writes unmanaged tuning in Play Mode.
meshing_profiles.csv is parsed from NativeArray byte scratch with ASCII key hashes and no managed row allocations.
Show Raw Extraction toggle draws yellow raw triangle wireframes from the raw float3 workspace in SceneView.

STRUCT.name: VoxelVertexDTO
STRUCT.MATH: 12+4+4+4+8=32 bytes. No Pack=1. GPU stride is exactly 32.

STRUCT.name: ChunkMeshingStateDTO
STRUCT.MATH: double3 24 + float3 12 + float 4 + int 4 + int 4 + int 4 + uint 4 + uint 4 + byte 1 + byte 1 + ushort 2 = 64.

STRUCT.name: VoxelMeshingTelemetryEntry
STRUCT.MATH: All black-box telemetry rows are fixed one-cache-line records. No shared atomic counter struct was introduced.

SELF_AUDIT.SCALABILITY_CURVE: When GlobalQualityWeight drops below 0.3, SurfaceNetExtractionJob collapses toward 25% density resolution through stride 4, uses nearest SDF sampling for normals, and biases vertices toward cell centers according to DecimationAggression. This bypasses high-tap trilinear density reads and removes fine vertices before GraphicsBuffer upload. At 1.0 the job uses full 32^3 cell traversal, trilinear SDF normal samples, richer packed material data, and raw debug capture when requested.

POINTER_ALIASING_AND_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.NO_ALIAS: Burst job NativeArray fields use NoAlias where applicable. Optional frustum plane container is safety-disabled only because it may be default when PlaneCount is zero.
POINTER_ALIASING_AND_DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.JOB_HANDLE_GRAPH: TryScheduleMockDensity consumes input JobHandle and outputs density JobHandle. TryScheduleHzbCull consumes visibility dependency and outputs HZB cull JobHandle. TryScheduleExtraction consumes density/previous handle and outputs extraction JobHandle, cadence-gated unless dirty/laser urgent. Upload dispatcher does not call Complete; caller must invoke it after dependency completion.

DEAR_LIE_CONFIRMATION.FAKE: Interior solid/void cells are culled before vertex emission. CPU UVs are planar; shader world-space sampling fakes seamless triplanar material detail. Frustum priority delays geometry behind the player.

COMPLEXITY.after: O(sign-crossing coarse cells + direct GPU memcpy)

STRUCT_LAYOUT_DELTA.NOTE: Runtime DTOs now use LayoutKind.Explicit with FieldOffset on every field. Sequential layout was removed from the Surface Nets runtime DTO set.

STRUCT.name: VoxelSurfacePhysicsBakeRequestDTO
STRUCT.MATH: 4+4+4+4+1+1+2+4+8=32. The 8-byte field starts at offset 24, so ARM64 alignment is explicit.

HZB_CULLING_DELTA.NOTE: VoxelSurfaceHzbCullJob no longer culls by center point alone. It projects all 8 AABB corners, clamps the screen rect, samples HZB at four rect corners plus center, and only culls if all sampled tiles agree that the nearest AABB depth is behind terrain depth. Invalid clip-space projection fails open to visible.

COMPLEXITY.after: O(8 corner projections + 5 HZB tile samples)
